item.title: Kansas Man Arrested By Troopers In Caldwell County
item.description: An Overland Park, Kansas, man was arrested by State Troopers in Caldwell County. At about 12:51 pm Wednesday, 33-year-old Bolaji Binuyo was arrested for alleged fleeing. He was taken to the Caldwell County Detention Center.

item.title: Filings For August Primary
item.description: The Livingston County Clerk’s Office received additional candidate filings for the August Primary Election. Republican Nancy Jo Parks filed for the 2nd Ward Committeewoman position. Republican Dean Brookshier filed for the 2nd Ward Committeeman position. Filing for the August Primary remains open through March 31st.
